tools.name: search_gear
tools.description: Search fitness gear: hand-picked /dp/ matches plus English (amazon.com) or Swedish (amazon.se) search links. Pass marketplace=amazon.com for US shoppers; marketplace/locale are optional (en-US → amazon.com, otherwise amazon.se).

tools.name: create_pack
tools.description: Create a gear pack (optionally pre-filled). Returns ownerUrl + shopUrl + editToken. marketplace=amazon.com gives amazon.com /dp/ links; optional (en-US → amazon.com, otherwise amazon.se).

tools.name: create_and_fill
tools.description: One call: create a pre-filled gift pack (same as create_pack). Returns ownerUrl + shopUrl + editToken. marketplace=amazon.com gives amazon.com /dp/ links; optional (en-US → amazon.com, otherwise amazon.se).

tools.name: add_item
tools.description: Add a gear item to an existing pack. Requires id + editToken; marketplace/locale optional.

tools.name: browse_catalog
tools.description: List hand-picked catalog products with /dp/ buy links: marketplace=amazon.com → US catalog (amazon.com/dp/ASIN?tag=sw-fitness-20), amazon.se → Swedish catalog (tag sw-fitness-21). If marketplace is omitted, en-US → amazon.com, otherwise amazon.se. Filter by goal/level/budgetBand/q.

tools.name: resolve_product
tools.description: Resolve ASIN, Amazon URL, or keywords to a buy URL (buyUrl + trackingTag) on amazon.com, amazon.se or another storefront. marketplace optional (en-US → amazon.com, otherwise amazon.se).
